rows.name: Bridge
rows.manor: Honest refusal - no external tool provider bound (bridge_unavailable, offline)

rows.name: Route
rows.manor: Choose/direct execution path (in a Branch chain a 59 atom is consumed as the Else marker, never as Route)

rows.name: Measure
rows.manor: Count selected-set cardinality only (kind/unit label is annotation, not a property measurement; property vocabulary deferred)

rows.name: Normalize
rows.manor: Convert differing scales/forms to common basis

rows.name: Group
rows.manor: Treat multiple targets as one collection

rows.name: Replace
rows.manor: Key rename old to new (refuses an occupied destination - replace_occupied, no mutation)

rows.name: Commit
rows.manor: Mark/accept current live state (live mark/accept only - no atomic isolation, no staging area; Revert covers only the Try checkpoint fields)

rows.name: Alias
rows.manor: Bind alternate expression to existing semantic identity

rows.name: Compose
rows.manor: Create reusable higher-order operation from Dells

positive_controls.name: Rollback
positive_controls.manor: Authority-mediated checkpoint restore (bare use denied; freeze + grant + confirm_rollback required)
